What We Do Purpose History What We Do Purpose History What We Do As a premier manufacturer of hygienic and chemical industrial mixing equipment for over 110+ years, we understand your business and are committed to delivering solutions to your toughest mixing challenges. Our experienced teams can assist you with your formulation and process to improve productivity, maximize yields, and lower ingredient costs by customizing a high-performance mixing system that meets your particular needs. Admix stands at the forefront of pioneering mixing, blending, and dispersing solutions for a myriad of hygienic and chemical industries, including but not limited to, the vibrant sectors of paints, varnishes, food and beverages, as well as pharmaceuticals. Boasting a rich legacy that spans over a hundred years in crafting cutting-edge mixing technologies, our unparalleled expertise empowers us to engineer custom equipment solutions. These tailor-made solutions not only align with but also surpass the contemporary demands for advanced technology, exceptional functionality, unsurpassed quality, and unparalleled value. Purpose At Admix, our purpose is to be a respected mixing equipment manufacturer and solution provider with a passion for excellence and a commitment to our customers and employee owners. History Since its inception in 1989, Admix has been at the forefront of developing cutting-edge mixing solutions tailored to overcome the most complex challenges in mixing, blending, dispersing, and homogenizing. Our distinction lies in the fusion of our advanced mixing technologies with customized scale-up assurances and in-depth application and ingredient knowledge. In a strategic move that marked a significant milestone, Admix Europe ApS, expanded its legacy by acquiring Diaf Pilvad, a company with a rich history dating back to 1912, in April 2022. This acquisition has not only merged two storied entities but has also rebranded Diaf Pilvad under the Admix Europe ApS name. Together, they now operate seamlessly from a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility nestled in the heart of Fredensborg, Denmark. This union symbolizes our commitment to innovation, trustworthiness, and support, ensuring that our clients receive unparalleled solutions and service from a team that now harbors over a century of combined experience and expertise.
